features.label: Refined pose
features.explanation: Preserve the original actions and simplify details so the subject’s posture remains complete and clear
features.evidence: The outstretched arms, fan and vertical hem together form a complete, stable pose.
features.zh: 保留原有动作，概括细节，使主体姿态完整而清楚
features.en: Preserve the original actions and simplify details so the subject’s posture remains complete and clear

features.label: Restrained fine lines
features.explanation: Describe forms with fine, steady lines of varied weight
features.evidence: The clothing’s outer contours are clear, while facial details and inner fold lines are relatively restrained.
features.zh: 以细而稳定、轻重有别的线条勾勒形体
features.en: Describe forms with fine, steady lines of varied weight

features.label: Restrained color
features.explanation: Use soft neutrals to support limited vermilion and pale colors, avoiding equal competition for attention among all colors
features.evidence: The vermilion clothing is the main color shape, made more focused by the pale hem and plain background.
features.zh: 以柔和中性色承托少量朱红与浅色，避免颜色平均争夺注意
features.en: Use soft neutrals to support limited vermilion and pale colors, avoiding equal competition for attention among all colors

features.label: Soft volume
features.explanation: Reduce cast shadows and suggest volume through subtle tonal gradations
features.evidence: Volume is suggested mainly through small color differences, with no strong cast shadow visible on the ground.
features.zh: 弱化投影，以细微色阶提示体积
features.en: Reduce cast shadows and suggest volume through subtle tonal gradations

features.label: Supporting open space
features.explanation: Reduce background detail within the original composition, letting blank space support the subjects
features.evidence: The background has very little detail, leaving a broad open area around the figure.
features.zh: 在原构图中降低背景细节，让空白承托主体
features.en: Reduce background detail within the original composition, letting blank space support the subjects

features.label: Delicate matte surface
features.explanation: Create delicate matte color fields with a faint fiber-like texture
features.evidence: The collection record specifies color on silk; the small web preview supports only an overall observation of a delicate matte appearance.
features.zh: 呈现细腻哑光的色面和轻微纤维般质感
features.en: Create delicate matte color fields with a faint fiber-like texture

features.label: Calm composure
features.explanation: Create a calm, composed character with inner strength
features.evidence: The pose is expansive but not exaggerated, with a restrained facial expression and an overall sense of calm composure.
features.zh: 营造沉静、端正而有内在力量的气质
features.en: Create a calm, composed character with inner strength

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
